Label: Escalation Loop (R1)
Description: Strike leads to retaliation leads to sunk political cost leads back to further strikes. Self-amplifying; does not stop on its own.

Label: Exhaustion Loop (B1)
Description: Hormuz closure leads to economic shock leads to pressure to de-escalate leads back to easing the closure, with a multi-week lag.

Label: War Containment Loop (B2)
Description: Emergent loop connecting R1 and B1 through two bridge links and, as of 20 Aug 2026, the Political Override node. In principle this loop constrains escalation; in practice the override element represents that constraint being consciously bypassed by political leadership rather than acted on. Formalized as a named loop 21 Aug 2026.
